mapper.sql: id, origin_name, store_name, file_path, ext, file_size, content_type, uploader_id, create_time, status, deleted, download_count
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO file_info (origin_name, store_name, file_path, ext, file_size, content_type, uploader_id, create_time, status, deleted, download_count) VALUES (#{originName}, #{storeName}, #{filePath}, #{ext}, #{fileSize}, #{contentType}, #{uploaderId}, #{createTime}, #{status}, 0, #{downloadCount})
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM file_info WHERE uploader_id = #{uploaderId} AND deleted = 0
AND ext IN #{e}
AND origin_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY create_time DESC, id DESC
SELECT ext AS ext, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM file_info WHERE uploader_id = #{uploaderId} AND deleted = 0 GROUP BY ext
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM file_info WHERE uploader_id = #{uploaderId} AND deleted = 0
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(download_count), 0) FROM file_info WHERE uploader_id = #{uploaderId} AND deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE file_info SET download_count = download_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
